description: This file defines a controller class 'PaymentMethod' for the checkout payment methods in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles rendering the payment method selection view, retrieving available payment methods, saving selected payment methods, adding comments, and managing user agreement acknowledgments during checkout.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller for managing checkout payment methods, presenting options, validating user selections, and handling related data during the checkout process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the checkout payment method selection view with relevant data and information, such as previously selected method, comments, and legal text.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods based on current cart state and session data; returns JSON with options or errors.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the selected payment method, updating session data, and returns success or error messages as JSON.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Attaches a customer comment to the order and updates the order record.

methods.name: agree
methods.description: Records user agreement to terms, stored in session data.
